dataset.name: RID – Roof Information Dataset
dataset.imagery_notice: Google Maps Static API imagery; provider limits use to non-commercial research/education and related fair-use purposes.

label_contract.roof_code_meaning: codes 0--15 are azimuth classes; code 16 is flat roof
label_contract.mapping_evidence: RID mask_generation.py initializes background to len(label_classes)=17; definitions.py maps codes 0--16 to 16 azimuth classes plus flat roof.
label_contract.validity: All 512x512 mask pixels have a provider-defined class code; imagery contains no alpha band or nodata declaration.
label_contract.caveat: An explicit class code does not prove that every visible roof pixel is annotated correctly or completely.
